Name: Rustic Tractor Garage
Author: LilyMods
Description:
[b][u][size=6][center]A Rustic Garage[/center][/size][/u][/b][center]

This is a texture redesign for the garage that comes with the glorious [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401]TractorMod[/url]
My intention was so that you could closely match it with the base game's stable.
[b]Choice of 5 Different roof variants for personalization, as seen in the pictures.

[/b]Added Paint functionality in 1.3.
Two types of configurable PaintMasks added.
One that matches the way the Vanilla version of the game handles colouring the stable.
Another that affects pretty much all of the wood that the Vanilla type doesn't, if you want it to match the rest.
Changing the PaintMask type requires a game restart.

[u][b][size=5]Installation:[/size][/b][/u]

Installation is now easier than ever as I have updated the mod to use Content Patcher!
No need to select a variant before downloading; Now you can simply change the variant at any time using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]MCM[/url]﻿!
Alternatively, you can manually do this with the packaged config.json if you don't want to use MCM for whatever reason. (Instructions Inside config)
By default, roof type is set to 'Vanilla' option.
[color=#999999]
[Unfortunately, painting is still not yet possible, but it will be when Stardew 1.6 is released, so keep your eyes peeled.][/color]

[color=#ffff00][size=5][b]Also check out my Tractor ReSkin![/b][/size][/color]
